items.title: Ellenbarrie falls 7.25% in week to Rs 342.00 after profit-taking; delivery volumes down 50%
items.text: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases fell from Rs.368.75 to Rs.342.00 in the week, against a 3.20% fall in the Sensex. It hit the upper circuit at Rs.394.95 on 29 Sep, then slid 3.56% on 30 Sep and 4.12% on 1 Oct. Delivery volumes were 50.03% below the five-day average, which the article reads as momentum trading rather than long-term conviction. This bears on how much of the specialty-gas story is already priced in.

items.title: Analysts lift Ellenbarrie FY27 revenue forecast 13% to Rs 5.1 bn; price target up 6.3% to Rs 380
items.text: Per Simply Wall St's report on analyst forecasts, 2027 revenue estimates rose from Rs 4.5 billion to Rs 5.1 billion (+13.3%), implying a 44% increase on the past 12 months' sales. EPS for 2027 moved only from Rs 10.20 to Rs 10.35 (+1.5%), and the consensus price target rose 6.3% to Rs 380. Higher sales expectations with near-flat earnings suggest growth is coming at lower margins, which matters for how much of the specialty-gas story the market credits to Ellenbarrie.

items.title: Stallion India to meet investors on 1 Oct after Khalapur start-up
items.text: Stallion India Fluorochemicals scheduled a group virtual meeting with analysts and investors for 1 October 2026 at 4:00 PM IST, with Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund, OHM Capital and Ambit Asset Management. The company said no unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed. It is a chance for fresh commentary on the Khalapur helium and specialty gas ramp-up.

items.title: Ellenbarrie wins Rs 480.73 crore BHEL order for 1,200 TPD air separation unit
items.text: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases was awarded a turnkey contract of Rs 480.73 crore (excluding GST) by BHEL to supply and erect a 1,200 TPD cryogenic air separation unit for BHEL's 2,000 TPD Coal to Ammonium Nitrate project at Jharsuguda, Odisha, with a 24-month execution timeline. The order exceeds the company's FY26 revenue of Rs 341.6 crore. It is bulk industrial-gas plant business rather than specialty or semiconductor gas, so it adds revenue visibility but does not by itself evidence the specialty-gas pivot.
